classification_rationale: The customer is chasing an overdue refund for a booking Haapaharju Oy itself cancelled due to a unit breakdown, which is a standard refund matter even though the tone is frustrated.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

We're sorry for the frustration here, and for the delay in getting this sorted.

You're right - when we have to cancel a confirmed booking because of an equipment breakdown on our side, our policy is a full refund of anything paid, plus a 10% goodwill credit toward a future rental. We can see this wasn't processed after the cancellation, and we're arranging it now: the full refund will be issued to your original payment method, along with the 10% goodwill credit applied to your account, without further delay.

We appreciate your patience, and thank you for flagging it - this shouldn't have taken this long.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
